name: Lance Sata
source:
Prince of Ira. He skips classes and is rumored to be a delinquent, thus no one goes near him. After a certain incident with this Lance, you swiftly grow closer and become acquainted with the pain of his past. Will you be able to save him—he, who knows the fear of having something precious taken away?

Indulgence: Shishitou peppers, tsukemono
Pastime: Drinking, smoking
